questions.question: Select the combination of letters that, when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series, will complete the letter series. ab _ _ bb _ _ aa _ ba _ _ ab _
questions.questionHtml:
Select the combination of letters that, when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given letter series, will complete the letter series.

ab _ _ bb _ _ aa _ ba _ _ ab _
questions.solution:
Given: ab _ _ bb _ _ aa _ ba _ _ ab _

Let us check through options.

1) ababbaab

a b a / b b b / a b a / a b b / a a a / a b b → It doesn't follow any pattern.

2) aaabbbab

a b a / a b b / a b a / a b b / a b a / a b b → It follows a certain pattern.

3) babaabaa

a b b / a b b / b a a / a a b / a b a / a b a → It doesn't follow any pattern.

4) bbaabbaa

a b b / b b b / a a a / a b b / a b a / a b a → It doesn't follow any pattern.

Hence, aaabbbab is correct.

questions.question: A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series. ABC, EFG, IJK, ?
questions.questionHtml:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

ABC, EFG, IJK, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

A + 1 = B; B + 1 = C; C + 2 = E;

E + 1 = F; F + 1 = G; G + 2 = I;

I + 1 = J; J + 1 = K; K + 2 = M

M + 1 = N; N + 1 = O

Hence, MNO is the correct answer.

questions.question: Find the missing term in the letter series. BGL, DIN, ______, HMR
questions.questionHtml:
Find the missing term in the letter series.

BGL, DIN, ______, HMR
questions.solution:
The logic here is as follows,

B + 2 = D, D + 2 = F, F + 2 = H

G + 2 = I, I + 2 = K, K + 2 = M

L + 2 = N, N + 2 = P, P + 2 = R

Thus the missing term is FKP.
